column1: # Tornect device words: golden vectors (docs/PLAN.md §B.6.1, decision M1-63). Frozen.
# h = Argon2id(password = key, salt = "tornect/v1/words/" || role, m = 65536 KiB, t = 1, p = 1, version 0x13, 8 bytes)
# words = the first 44 bits of h, big-endian, as four 11-bit indices into the BIP39 English list
# Keys are invented byte patterns, not anyone's key. Every platform must reproduce every line.
